blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY, Philippines — The city government has formed an evaluation committee to review an unsolicited proposal for the implementation of the Baguio City No-Contact Apprehension Program (NCAP). In a statement Sunday (Nov. 15), the city government said Executive Order No. 176, series of 2026, signed by Mayor Benjamin Magalong, created the committee, which will be chaired by Engr. Rodrigo Martinez of the City Engineering Office. The committee will include representatives from various city government offices, the Baguio City Police Office and the City Council. Police Col.
